title: infra.node.replaced v1 data
description: A cluster node was replaced. Reported after the replacement joined and the old member was removed, so a consumer never sees a half-replaced pair. Evolved additively within v1: new OPTIONAL fields only. A new required field, a removed field or a retyped field is a v2.

talosVersion.description: Talos version the new node booted, as reported by the node — not the pinned value from config.

etcdMemberRemoved.description: Control planes only: whether the old etcd member was removed from the member list. False here means quorum arithmetic still counts the old member.
